Adults Only Chess Club - Elite Chess Center

Join Us For Weekly Chess Fun!

Description: Join us for our weekly adult chess club at the Elite Chess Center! Our club's goal is to provide a laid back, welcoming place for adults to play and connect with other adults who love the game of chess.

Eligibility: At least 18 years old and not in high school.

Where: Elite Chess Center in Naperville. 

Address: 2916 W. Ogden Ave, Suite 120, Naperville, IL 60540

Rounds: Doors Open at 6:30pm. There is no official check-in.  Round 1 at 12:30pm sharp, rest ASAP.

Membership Fee:  $30 for the year after 2 free visits

Membership Benefits:  Members are allowed to attend our Friday night club meetings, participate in our Friday events/trainings for free, get 20% off of all Elite Chess Tournaments, check out books from our library, and play on our CICL Team!

*Note:  Drugs, alcohol, and tobacco are strictly prohibited.  We are in the business of teaching kids, therefore these items are not allowed anywhere on the premises.

Photographs/Video: By registering you agree to allow photographs and video from the club, that may contain your image, to be posted on our website or social media. Player names may also be used in photos or videos.
